checkpoints.description: [1/2] Emit structured replay failures in --json mode

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed replay failures still print prose under --json, unlike every other command result after ADR-020.
impact_assessment.benefits: Agent consumers can parse both successful and failed replays uniformly.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new JSON error object, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Branch only the error print on json_mode, keep the same return code and human text, and add failing-first tests for bad URL and unreachable target.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Capture non-GET requests sent to read-only control paths

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed POST /__inbox and PUT /__health get a control response and are never captured, breaking the any-method capture contract.
impact_assessment.benefits: No webhook is silently discarded because of its path; only GET/HEAD keep the control responses.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: non-GET requests to those paths change from control response to capture, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Gate the two read-only handlers on method in _route, add raw-socket failing-first tests, and keep GET/HEAD behaviour unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Done: non-GET/HEAD requests to /__inbox and /__health are captured; 96 tests green
[2/2] Done: README control-path rule and ADR-022
[2/2] Phase 4 passed: 5/5 gates green, 96 tests

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Include Allow: POST, DELETE in the clear-endpoint 405 response

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed GET /__clear returns 405 without the Allow header required for that status.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clients can discover the supported clear methods from the response itself.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: an extra response header only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add optional headers to _send_json, send Allow on the clear 405, and add a raw-socket failing-first test.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Done: 405 response includes Allow: POST, DELETE; 97 tests green

checkpoints.head: 58fc26bf102c234d8438f0c1fab52363370bc0d1

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Dedupe ids within a snapshot and reject duplicate Content-Length headers

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a snapshot with the same id twice imports both and makes the records unusable, and two conflicting Content-Length values are accepted with a truncated body.
impact_assessment.benefits: Imports cannot create ambiguous ids, and smuggling-shaped requests are refused.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: malformed HTTP gets 400 instead of 200, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: duplicate ids are skipped before any store write.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Track seen ids during import, use headers.get_all to detect multiple lengths before reading a body, and add failing-first tests for both.
